notes:
Magento site, UAE storefront at /ae-en/ (English). No robots.txt Claude-specific block (generic '*' group Allow:/ , only an OAI-SearchBot group differs - not more restrictive for us). Fetched directly, no WAF issues. Category tree mapped from the mega-menu (Homeware section) plus each listing page's own 'subcategories-content' tiles, cross-checked against the exact power-listing toolbar count div (
N Item(s)
) on every leaf page - this is the site's authoritative exact count, more reliable than any text/JSON pattern probe.py's generic heuristics found. RULE 1 catch: several 'anchor' parent categories (Dinnerware, Serveware, Drinkware, Home Decor) show MORE total products than the sum of their own listed subcategories, because some products are tagged directly to the parent without being placed in any child listing. Verified this empirically by diffing full product-URL sets (parent vs union of children): Dinnerware parent=90 vs Loose Crockery(52)+Dinner Sets(6)+Cutlery(15)=73, gap of 17 untagged loose-crockery-type items (plates/bowls/cups) folded into the Loose Crockery leaf qty below (52+17=69). Serveware parent=63 vs children sum 60: 3 untagged serving bowls folded into Serving Dishes (41+3=44). Drinkware parent=97-98 vs children sum 92: of the 5 untagged items, Aeris Pitcher and Odilia Jug are decorative serveware (folded into Drink Serveware, 3+2=5); the other 3 (2 vacuum flasks, 1 'sipper' bottle) are functional drinkware, excluded like the rest of the Vaccum Flasks branch. Home Decor parent=79 vs named-children sum 44 (excl. Decor Accents): the 35-item gap is almost entirely the untagged Decor Accents subcategory itself (27 items, separately verified via its own URL) plus 8 more loose items (Millia Tissue Box Cover, Vogue Book Holder = decorative, folded into Decor Accents; Renata Desk Organiser and a UK power adaptor = not decor, excluded; Rivia Jar Candle White Bloom and Voyage Incense Sticks = fragrance, excluded; Semplice Taper Candle-10pcs and Semplice Votive Candle-10pcs = unscented candle line, folded into Candles). Lighting parent (25) and Wall Décor parent (27) matched their children sums exactly - no hidden items there. RULE 0 gains: 'Outdoor Accessories' (a top-level nav item outside the Homeware>Lighting tree) turned out to be a single outdoor lamp - folded into Lighting as Outdoor Lighting per Rule 0.1/0.2 (product type beats the non-room 'Outdoor Accessories' label). MIXED ROLL-UP FILTERING (Rule 0, 'drop don't pad', title-level inspection, not padding): (1) 'Candles' subcat (20 items) - the site files these under Home Decor not Home Fragrances, but 17/20 are explicitly scented (named by fragrance, e.g. 'Jasmine & Iris', 'Amber Oud', 'Pomegranate Noir') and excluded per the Home Fragrance/scented-candle rule; only the 3 unscented 'Semplice' line items (Tealight, Taper Set of 4pcs, Pillar) plus 2 more same-line unscented items found in the Home Decor overflow (Taper-10pcs, Votive-10pcs) are counted = 5. Verified no fragrance/scent copy on the Semplice product pages. (2) 'Candle Holders' subcat (9 items) is itself mixed: 5 genuine candle holders (Makrien, 2x Leafy Dahlia, 2x Leafy Lily) counted; 4 scented jar candles miscategorized into this listing were excluded. (3) 'Decor Accents' (27 items) is 15/27 Christmas/holiday decor (nutcrackers, hanging ornaments, Christmas trees, placemats, top stars, wreaths) - excluded per the Holiday & Gift rule; 12 are genuine year-round decor accents, plus the 2 folded-in items above = 14. (4) 'Wall Accessories' (3 items) mixes 1 bath fixture (Wall Mounted Shower Caddy, excluded) with 2 decorative wall hooks (Claudia Hooks, Maribele Hooks) - only the 2 hooks counted, filed under Wall Décor as 'Wall Hooks'. (5) 'Napkins & Accessories' (3 items) mixes 2 decorative napkin rings (counted) with 1 apron (textile, excluded). (6) 'Pots & Planters' (24 items) excludes 2 plant-bundled products (Cactus Plant With Pot, Radermachera Sinica Tree With Pot) since the primary product is a plant, not a bare planter; 22 counted. EXCLUDED WHOLESALE (checked, not decorative/in-scope): Bathroom Storage(31), Laundry(13), Bath Accessories(107 - all functional bath fixtures: soap dishes, dispensers, tumblers, toilet brush holders, waste bins, no decorative items found across sampled titles), Ladders & Stools/tall-hangers (furniture), Cutlery(15, flatware), Trolleys(2, furniture serving carts), Food Warmers & Casseroles(10, cookware), Vaccum Flasks branch (functional insulated drinkware), Table Covers/Placemat & Runners (textile), Cruet Set & Oil Pourer(0, empty), Bulbs & Accessories(3: LED/CF bulbs + a UK extension cord - no non-bulb decor found), Home Fragrances (both the top-level nav entry and the Home Decor>Home Fragrances branch), Curtains & Blinds, Plants & Trees/artificial-plants(12) and Artificial Flowers(36) under Garden (faux plants rule), Home Linen (bed/bath linen, cushions, rugs - all textile), Stationary/general-accessories, Kitchen Mats/Cookware/Pots & Pans/Storage/Utility Essentials/Kitchen Tools & Utensils. Top-nav shortcut links (/ae-en/dinnerware/, /cutlery/, /glassware/, /serveware/) all 301/canonicalize to the exact same homeware/kitchen-dining/... URLs already captured - confirmed duplicates, not separate listings (Rule 0.6). Bathroom Cabinet & Mirrors and Fountains and Photo Frames are legitimate site categories currently showing 0 Item(s) on their toolbar - recorded as qty 0 rather than omitted, per Rule 3 (an empty listing is a real, verified answer). No duplicate-company flag applies to S.N. 195 in this window's roster.
